summary: Join our Office Operations for Support Staff Training Course to master key skills that boost workplace efficiency and support team success.
lede: Office operations training helps administrative and support teams coordinate workplace services with clearer ownership and consistent controls. It is for office coordinators, executive assistants, administrative supervisors, and facilities support staff who need to organize requests, records, schedules, and supplier follow-up. Participants practise mapping workflows, setting service priorities and escalation paths, controlling records in shared systems, and designing digital request and approval processes.
audienceIntro: This office operations course is designed for professionals who coordinate administrative services, workplace requests, information flows, schedules, suppliers, and support processes. It suits experienced support staff who want a more controlled operating model, as well as supervisors who need practical tools for managing service quality and digital workflows.
prerequisites: You should have at least six months of experience in office administration, executive support, facilities coordination, records administration, business support, or a related workplace services role. You need practical familiarity with email, spreadsheets, shared folders, and routine administrative workflows. No programming is required. Power Automate, Power BI, and advanced records management concepts are taught at conceptual and operational application level, while workflow mapping, dashboard design, and control checklists receive hands-on practice.
